overall: No violation found: the Commission could keep its July 29, 2010 collective bargaining executive session minutes confidential because the bargaining issue remained unresolved. The AG strongly encouraged release once it no longer jeopardized bargaining, and the June 17 minutes were already released.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission violated the OML by withholding July 29, 2010 executive session minutes after the reason for confidentiality ended.
allegations.key_passage: Both you and Town Administrator Kwiatkowski have attested that the collective bargaining issues discussed at the July 29, 2010 executive session remain unresolved, and that no collective bargaining agreement has been reached.

allegations.summary: Complaint also sought release of June 17, 2010 executive session minutes, which the AG found had already been released.
allegations.key_passage: we understand that the June 17, 2010 minutes have been released, thus the only issue remaining for our consideration is the release of the July 29, 2010 minutes.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
